startState.head: bb3d081d271e9de204c6fe610ef81dba71f898a9
startState.priorDisposition: saitama-raiboc-main was ADOPT / implementation-ready per the 2026-08-30 KANTO >=1000 HIGH-IMPACT UNRESEARCHED PREFLIGHT 2 (data/venue-reports/kanto-ge1000-high-impact-unresearched-preflight-2-2026-08-30.json).

scope: saitama-raiboc-main / RaiBoC Hall〔大ホール〕 only. chiba-pref-culture-main, remaining Kanto inventory-unresearched research, known HARD-CASE records, and Tokyo Priority D were explicitly out of scope and not touched.

evidence: https://saitama-culture.jp/raibochall/ (fetched 2026-08-31): active operation, regular closure only on the 2nd/4th Wednesday; upcoming programme includes 'RaiBoC Hall New Year Concert 2027' announced 2026-08-29 and 'THE CLASSICAL LEGEND!! Concert Session 2' announced 2026-08-29; no closure/renovation/cessation notice found on the top page.

https://saitama-culture.jp/raibochall/hall/ (fetched 2026-08-31): current 大ホール capacity stated as 客席数：1,400席; no closure/renovation notice; states 音響反響板 setup/teardown takes about 2.5-3 hours and restricts stage/audience-area access during that work, but does not state any seat-number change.
No dedicated accessibility page exists on the site; no barrier-free/車いす page found in the top-page navigation listing.
currentnessGate.conclusion: No formal closure/renovation/cessation within 12 months of the review date was found; booking/event activity is confirmed into 2027. Currentness gate PASS, proceeded to two-pass transcription.

currentSeatChartEvidence.derivationPath: Fetched https://saitama-culture.jp/raibochall/hall/ fresh on 2026-08-31 and followed its own '座席表（大ホール）' link, rather than trusting the URL recorded by the prior preflight as still current-linked without re-derivation.
currentSeatChartEvidence.assetType: Single-page vector PDF; seat numbers, row labels, headers, and gate labels are drawn as vector curve paths, not embedded selectable text (pdftotext / pymupdf get_text extracted only the 7 GATE labels; individual seat numbers are not machine-extractable).

configurationAssessment.officialCapacity: 現行 https://saitama-culture.jp/raibochall/hall/ states 客席数：1,400席 with no floor/area breakdown on that page.
configurationAssessment.chartHeaderBreakdown: The seat chart itself prints: 1階席 938席／多目的鑑賞室 3席（※車いすスペース 4〜13席）／2階席 431席／バルコニー 28席　計1400席。
configurationAssessment.fixedVsMovable: 大ホール page states fixed seating for 大ホール (no movable-chair note, unlike 小ホール which explicitly has movable rear chairs).
configurationAssessment.reflectorBoardEffect: The hall page describes 音響反響板 setup/teardown time and access restriction only; it does not state that reflector-board setup changes the seat-number set. No second configuration is issuer-defined.
configurationAssessment.wheelchairPositions: Four wheelchair pictograms are printed on the chart (two in 1F row I in place of the unprinted 4-7 position, two in place of the unprinted 40-43 position), consistent with the header's stated minimum of 4 in the '車いすスペース 4〜13席' range. No seat ID is printed at any wheelchair pictogram position.
configurationAssessment.issuerDefinedAreas: 1階 (rows A-W), 2階 (rows 2B-2K), and four side balcony boxes labelled LA/LB/RA/RB on the chart itself (their combined 28 mapped seats exactly equal the chart's own printed バルコニー 28席 figure, corroborating the area assignment). A 多目的鑑賞室 (3 seats) is drawn as an unnumbered grid and excluded from the numbered scope.
configurationAssessment.decision: A single coherent numbered configuration is definable directly from the current issuer chart; proceeded to transcription under scope.kind: official-variant (not fixed-only, since the whole issuer-drawn seating area is registered, not a fixed-stand subset).

verificationMethodDecision.denseVectorRejectedBecause: The chart is a single ordinary theater/hall seat map (~1,384-1,400 seats across ~30 rows), not a super-high-density diagram; the DENSE-VECTOR exception in docs/VENUE_DATA_GUIDE.md requires that human visual two-pass be unreasonable, which does not hold here. Standard direct human visual two-pass was used throughout.

visualPass1.renderMethod: PyMuPDF render of the first fetch at 6x zoom (3572x5052 px) from a locally rendered PNG, cropped and read in sections.
visualPass1.readingOrder: Header, then 1F front rows A-I left-to-right, then 1F rear rows J-W left-to-right, then balcony boxes LA/LB/RA/RB, then 多目的鑑賞室, then 2F rows 2B-2K left-to-right.
visualPass1.recorded: Floor/area, row, printed seat IDs, range start/end, split ranges, unprinted wheelchair-icon positions, X-cross marks over printed numbers (row I), diagonal-hatch marks over printed numbers (row R), and per-row subtotals.

visualPass2.renderMethod: PyMuPDF render of a second, independently re-fetched copy of the PDF at 7x zoom (4168x5894 px), a different zoom factor and a fresh crop/segmentation strategy from Pass 1.
visualPass2.readingOrder: Row order and left/right reading direction were reversed relative to Pass 1 (2K before 2B; W before A; each row's opposite end read first) rather than reusing Pass 1's range table as an answer key.
visualPass2.mismatchFound: Pass 2's first re-read of 1F rows H and I, cross-checked against Pass 1's notes only after both were drafted, disagreed on which row carried the wheelchair pictograms and the X-cross marks.
visualPass2.resolution: Returned to the current official chart (not to either pass's notes) and re-cropped a single wide image spanning rows B through I with every row label visible simultaneously and directly touching its own row of numbers. This resolved the disagreement unambiguously: row H is fully plain (3-44, no marks of any kind); row I carries both wheelchair pictograms (replacing the unprinted 4-7 and 40-43 positions) and all X-cross marks (over printed 10-13, 17-20, 23-24, 27-30, 34-37). Pass 1's original H/I attribution was corrected to match this re-confirmed reading before comparison closed. All other rows (R's diagonal-hatch on 16-31, W's isolation to 16-31, row J starting at 2, the 2B-2F right-side continuity, row 2K's four-segment structure, and the LA/LB/RA/RB seat counts) were independently re-confirmed in Pass 2 and matched Pass 1 without further correction.

matchResult.notes: The single H/I mismatch was resolved by returning to the current official chart with a wider, label-anchored crop, not by guesswork, majority vote, or capacity fitting. No other field (complete printed ID set, floor/area ownership, row ownership, every range, every gap, accessibility markings, per-area subtotal) had an unresolved disagreement.

reconciliation.relationToOfficial1400: The chart's own header arithmetic is 938 (1F) + 3 (多目的鑑賞室) + 431 (2F) + 28 (バルコニー) = 1400. The registered numbered scope (1F + 2F + バルコニー, excluding the unnumbered 多目的鑑賞室) is 942 + 414 + 28 = 1384 against the chart's own numbered-scope subtotal of 938 + 431 + 28 = 1397, a difference of 13, and against the full 1,400 a difference of 16.
reconciliation.wheelchairPositionsIncludedIn1400: Not determinable from issuer text; the wheelchair pictograms occupy positions where no seat number is printed at all (not counted as numbered seats in this registration either way).
reconciliation.replacementRelationToOrdinarySeats: Not issuer-defined; no numbered seat is stated to be replaced by a specific wheelchair position, so no seat ID was deleted or invented.
reconciliation.movableRemovableSeats: None found; the 大ホール hall page describes 大ホール seating as fixed (unlike 小ホール).
reconciliation.orchestraStageEffectOnSeatCount: Not issuer-defined for numbered seats; reflector-board setup affects stage access time only per current evidence.
reconciliation.unnumberedTechnicalOrAccessibilityPositi: The four wheelchair pictogram positions (1F row I) and the 多目的鑑賞室 (3 unnumbered positions) are excluded from the numbered scope as unnumbered.
reconciliation.unexplainedMarks: 1F row I carries X-cross marks over 18 printed numbers (10-13, 17-20, 23-24, 27-30, 34-37) and 1F row R carries a diagonal single-line hatch over all 16 printed numbers 16-31. No legend for either mark was found anywhere on the one-page chart (all four corners and both margins were checked and are blank). Because the seat numbers under both marks are printed exactly like unmarked seats, and docs/VENUE_DATA_GUIDE.md's precedent for a directly comparable case (mito-civic-globis-hall's 2F shaded/network cells, which retain their printed numbers as ordinary numbered seats without a legend) supports registering printed-but-marked numbers rather than deleting them on an unsupported assumption, both marks were kept in the mapped/orderable range rather than excluded. This is recorded as an open verification note in the source's unresolvedIssues, not resolved by inference.
